headline: Radar
blurb: Hand-picked companies that are easy to miss in a normal sweep — quiet Gem boards, Zoho careers pages, incubator pins, Remote India roles. The public map and job feed stay free; Radar is the editorial layer on top.

entries.why: YC life-sciences voice AI. Careers live on Gem with Remote India eng roles — easy to miss if you only scrape Greenhouse/Ashby.
Pharma track-and-trace SaaS in Kondapur. On-site Hyd hiring; not on big ATS aggregators.
Funded robotics / AI team in Kondapur — careers page is easy to overlook.
Agritech robotics; hiring via Zoho Recruit, not Greenhouse/Lever.
Edge AI silicon with a real Gachibowli office (DLF Cyber City) — often listed as US-only.
IIIT / CIE Vindhya space startup — small board, easy to miss in funding lists.
Aerospace manufacturing outside the usual HITEC corridor — easy to skip in city-center sweeps.
EV / BMS hardware at Narsingi coworking — not on mainstream ATS feeds.
Optical payloads for drones/space; Peeramcheru base.
Smart-home hardware HQ in Banjara Hills — careers buried on the marketing site.
Education-loan marketplace at Sanali Spazio — solid Hyd team, quiet careers surface.
Early AI healthtech at D-Labs / ISB — tiny funding, easy to skip.
AI team at T-Hub 2.0 — incubator address, easy to miss outside T-Hub lists.
Open-source project management; Hyd + SF hiring — often filed under Bangalore/remote only.
Health assurance platform with a real Madhapur office.
